title: Astral Wand
pages: Craft with an amethyst shard, a blaze rod and a gold ingot, in that column. The wand holds no lumen itself; it draws charge only from a nearby Astral Font.

Right-click to cast the wand's current spell. It searches a six block radius around you for the fullest Astral Font holding enough lumen, spends the cost from it, then fires. If no font nearby holds enough lumen, nothing is spent and you are told so.

Lumen Bolt costs 40 lumen and strikes the first living target along a straight line up to 12 blocks, dealing 6 magic damage. Resonance Pulse costs 65 lumen and damages nearby hostile creatures within 4 blocks for 3 magic damage, slowing them briefly; passive creatures are spared.

Astral Lance costs 90 lumen and pierces every living creature along its line up to 16 blocks, dealing 4 magic damage to each and making them glow briefly, unlike Lumen Bolt which stops at the first target.

Starfall costs 110 lumen and lands its damage at the point you are aiming at, up to 20 blocks away, rather than along a line. Every living creature within 3 blocks of that impact point takes 7 magic damage and catches fire for 3 seconds, striking a cluster of enemies at range instead of whatever stands directly between you and them.

Arc Chain costs 55 lumen and strikes the first living target along a line up to 14 blocks for 5 magic damage, then leaps to the nearest other living creature within 5 blocks of the one it just struck, dealing 3 magic damage and weakening each creature it touches. It makes up to two leaps in total, each needing another target close enough, spreading damage across a scattered group instead of hitting one spot or one line.

Dusk Fan costs 75 lumen and strikes hostile creatures within 6 blocks in a forward cone. Each takes 4 magic damage and is blinded for 4 seconds. Creatures behind you and passive animals are spared, making it useful when facing a group near allies or livestock.

Gravity Well costs 85 lumen and forms a pull point where you aim, up to 16 blocks away. Hostile creatures within 4 blocks take 2 magic damage, are pulled toward the point, and are slowed for 3 seconds. Passive animals are spared. Use it to gather scattered enemies before another attack.

Repulsion Burst costs 70 lumen and deals 3 magic damage to hostile creatures within 4 blocks, pushing them away from you. Passive animals and distant enemies are spared. Use it to create room when surrounded; keep an Astral Font nearby to supply the wand.

Skyward Surge costs 80 lumen and deals 3 magic damage to hostile creatures within 4 blocks, launching them upward. Passive animals and distant enemies are spared. Use it to interrupt nearby attackers or gain room to escape; the wand still needs a charged Astral Font within reach.

Withering Sigil costs 95 lumen and strikes the nearest hostile creature within 8 blocks for 2 magic damage, then inflicts Wither for 5 seconds. Other hostile creatures and passive animals are spared. Use it against a tough single enemy; the wand draws its charge from a nearby Astral Font.

Siphon Mark costs 100 lumen and strikes the nearest hostile creature within 6 blocks for 3 magic damage. When the strike lands, it restores 2 health to you, up to your normal maximum. It spares passive creatures and other hostiles; a blocked strike gives no healing.

Nullifying Brand costs 105 lumen and strikes the nearest hostile creature within 8 blocks for 4 magic damage. A successful strike strips that creature's beneficial status effects, such as Resistance or Strength, while leaving harmful effects in place. Other hostiles and passive creatures are spared; a blocked strike does not dispel effects.

Binding Snare costs 60 lumen and deals 2 magic damage to every hostile creature within 5 blocks. It also roots them in place for 3 seconds, halting their movement outright, and clears any motion they already had. Passive creatures are untouched. Use it to stop a group from closing in or to hold enemies still for a follow-up spell.

Finishing Gleam costs 90 lumen and strikes the nearest hostile within 8 blocks. It deals 2 magic damage to an unwounded target, plus 1 damage for every 2 health that target is missing, capped at 10 damage. Other hostiles and passive creatures are spared. Wound a durable enemy first, then use this spell to finish it efficiently.

Aegis Ward costs 120 lumen and is mainly defensive. As it forms, the ward flares outward and deals 2 magic damage to every hostile within 3 blocks, sparing passive animals and anything farther away. Casting it also grants 10 seconds of Absorption and a reflecting ward. Any living creature that lands a hit on you while the ward holds takes 3 magic damage bounced straight back at it, so an attacker that keeps swinging keeps paying for it. Use it before wading into a melee you expect to take hits in.

Harmonic Reversal costs 115 lumen and sends a pulse 5 blocks around you. Every hostile creature in range takes 3 magic damage, while you and each nearby living non-hostile recover up to 2 health, limited by their normal maximum. It still heals if no hostile is nearby. Use it to protect livestock and companions while pushing back attackers; distant creatures are untouched.

Blink Strike costs 130 lumen and, unlike every other spell, moves you instead of just striking: you blink up to 6 blocks forward along the direction you are facing, stopping short of any solid wall in the way rather than passing through it. On arrival, every hostile within 3 blocks of where you land takes 4 magic damage. Use it to close distance on a fleeing target or to jump into the middle of a scattered group.

Discordant Call costs 95 lumen. It finds the nearest pair of hostile mobs within 8 blocks of you and 5 blocks of each other, deals 2 magic damage to each, then turns them against one another. It leaves passive creatures and unpaired hostiles alone. Cast near a cluster to redirect attackers while you retreat; the spell still consumes lumen if no eligible pair is present.

Rift Exchange costs 110 lumen. It swaps the positions of the two nearest hostile mobs within 8 blocks of you and deals 3 magic damage to each. Use it to pull a distant attacker into another's position or disrupt two approaching enemies. Passive creatures and hostiles outside the radius are untouched; lumen is still spent if fewer than two hostiles qualify.

Arcane Fury costs 100 lumen. It strikes the nearest hostile within 4 blocks for 4 magic damage as you enter the fight, then grants 10 seconds of Strength II and Speed II. It spares passive creatures and distant hostiles; you still gain the buffs when no hostile is nearby. Cast it before closing into melee or pursuing a fleeing target.

Shift-right-click cycles the wand's spell mode through Lumen Bolt, Resonance Pulse, Astral Lance, Starfall, Arc Chain, Dusk Fan, Gravity Well, Repulsion Burst, Skyward Surge, Withering Sigil, Siphon Mark, Nullifying Brand, Binding Snare, Finishing Gleam, Aegis Ward, Harmonic Reversal, Blink Strike, Discordant Call, Rift Exchange and Arcane Fury in order. The selected mode is stored on the wand, so you can prepare it before approaching a Font.
Casting has a short cooldown between uses. Industrial power cannot substitute for lumen; only Astral Fonts under open night sky supply this offense.

Every spell has its own impact sound, played where it actually lands rather than at you: a bolt cracks, a pulse thumps, a curse sours, a ward rings. A miss stays silent, so the sound tells you which creatures were struck even out of sight. At most four impacts sound per cast, and an Aegis Ward reflection rings with the ward's impact.

Wands and the Phase Scepter take enchanting-table or anvil-book tunings, each a trade-off up to level III. Overchannel adds 50% lumen cost and 25% damage per level; Quickcast cuts the cooldown 25% but damage 15% per level; Lumen Thrift cuts lumen cost 20% but lengthens the cooldown 50% per level. Tunings exclude each other, so pick one. The tooltip shows the tuned cost, damage and cooldown, and hoppers or Font automation are unaffected.
